title: Snack Addition Stories
shareTitle: Snack Addition Stories — Add, Count, and Picnic
description: Bring two snack groups together on a kawaii picnic tray, count the total within six, and invent your own addition stories.
learningGoals: Model addition as joining two visible groups
Connect a spoken add-together story to a complete addition equation
interactionModel: Choose a narrated story, tap a whole arriving snack group or add its snacks one at a time, then choose the matching total from three large answer cookies; My Picnic supports open-ended adding and removing on either side of the tray.
feedbackModel: Every added snack visibly joins the same tray. A gentle count-together retry pulses each snack without penalty; correct totals resolve the live equation, bring in the sun guide, play recorded praise, and celebrate on the unchanged tableau.

modes.title: Snack Counter
modes.skill: one-to-one addition and total counting within 6
